result.violated_requirement: Shift register must shift input into LSB and shift previous bits left; mutant shifts input into MSB and shifts previous bits right.
result.spec_basis: Shift Register Behavior: On every positive edge of the clock, if rst_n is asserted (logic 1), the input a should be shifted into the least significant bit (LSB) of the shift register a_tem, and the previous bits should shift left by one position.
